scenarios.name: Hero Section Display and Layout
scenarios.description: Verify the hero section displays correctly with value proposition headline, tagline, and call-to-action buttons

steps.description: Navigate to the homepage as an unauthenticated user
steps.context: User is not logged in and visits the root URL

steps.description: Check that the gradient headline is visible and properly styled
steps.context: Hero section should be prominently displayed above the fold

steps.description: Confirm Get Started and Login buttons are displayed with correct visual hierarchy
steps.context: Primary button (Get Started) should be more prominent than secondary (Login)

test_cases.input: Render Home component with unauthenticated user context
test_cases.expected: Hero section renders with headline text containing value proposition

test_cases.input: Check for Get Started button presence
test_cases.expected: FuturisticButton with 'Get Started' text is rendered and visible
FuturisticButton with 'Login' text is rendered and visible
Get Started button has primary styling, Login button has secondary styling

scenarios.name: Feature Cards Display
scenarios.description: Verify feature cards section displays all service capabilities with proper styling and layout

steps.description: Navigate to the homepage
Scroll down to view the feature cards grid
steps.context: Features section should be below the hero

steps.description: Confirm all 6 feature cards are displayed with icons, titles, and descriptions

test_cases.input: Render Home component and query for feature cards
test_cases.expected: Exactly 6 GlassMorphismCard components are rendered in the features section
Each card contains an icon, title text, and description text
Cards have consistent spacing and alignment in grid layout
Cards display appropriate hover feedback with visual change

Visit homepage while logged in

test_cases.expected: Get Started button links to /register route
Get Started button links to /dashboard route

test_cases.input: Click Get Started as unauthenticated user
test_cases.expected: User is navigated to registration page

test_cases.input: Click Get Started as authenticated user
test_cases.expected: User is navigated to dashboard page

scenarios.name: Theme Mode Support

Check that all elements have appropriate light mode colors and contrast
steps.context: Card backgrounds should use light mode values

steps.description: Toggle theme to dark mode
Check that all elements adapt to dark mode with proper colors
steps.context: Card backgrounds should use dark mode values

test_cases.expected: Component renders with light mode CSS classes applied
Component renders with dark mode CSS classes applied

test_cases.input: Toggle theme from light to dark
test_cases.expected: All homepage elements transition smoothly to dark mode styling

test_cases.input: Verify text contrast in light mode
test_cases.expected: Text elements meet 4.5:1 contrast ratio against light backgrounds

test_cases.input: Verify text contrast in dark mode
test_cases.expected: Text elements meet 4.5:1 contrast ratio against dark backgrounds

scenarios.name: Background Effect Rendering

steps.description: Navigate to homepage and wait for full render
Check that Three.js canvas is rendered in the DOM
steps.context: Canvas should be positioned behind content

steps.description: Confirm particle animation is active and rendering
steps.context: Animation should be subtle and not distracting

test_cases.expected: BackgroundEffect component is mounted and canvas element exists in DOM
Canvas has position fixed or absolute with z-index behind content
Three.js resources are properly disposed on component unmount

test_cases.input: Check for memory leaks after mount/unmount cycles
test_cases.expected: No memory leaks detected after multiple mount/unmount cycles

steps.description: Watch for headline and tagline entrance animations

test_cases.expected: Hero section elements have initial, animate, and transition props
